scripts.dev:all: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const b = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); const f = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { b.kill(); f.kill(); process.exit(); });"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
